case_title.quote: Ram Singh v. The State of U.P.

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided on appeal; the co-accused was acquitted at trial.

accused_gender.quote: Ram Singh was holding a country made pistol in his right hand

accused_caste.reason: The community is not named, so caste is not stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Only pending cross cases are mentioned; no prior record is stated.

victim_gender.quote: His mother Dulli was sitting close by on a cot

accused_victim_relationship.quote: he had a rivalry with accused Ram Singh in connection with the election of village Pradhan
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The enmity is with the informant son, and the accused is from the same village.

offence_category.quote: convicted under Section 301 read with Section 302

statutory_provisions.quote: charging appellant Ram Singh of having committed offence under Sections 301 and 302 of the IPC as well as under Section 307/34

weapon.quote: the country made pistol used by the accused in the offence, could not be recovered

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life... rigorous imprisonment for five years, both the sentences to run concurrently

high_court_outcome.quote: was dismissed. Consequently, the conviction and sentence of the appellant imposed by the Sessions Court was confirmed

final_outcome.quote: we set aside the conviction and sentence of the accused
final_outcome.reason: Appeal allowed and conviction set aside, which is acquittal.

offence_finally_established.quote: we set aside the conviction and sentence

imprisonment_type.quote: we set aside the conviction and sentence of the accused

imprisonment_years.reason: Null is right since there is no sentence.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the 'targeted son' bending detail as a settled fact, and the 'midnight' report phrasing; keep evidence neutral and avoid noting missing witnesses as conclusions.
neutral_facts.quote: Omission to examine Desh Raj by the prosecution is most crucial
neutral_facts.reason: Largely accurate but includes court-style evaluations such as the non-examination of witnesses and the 'differing accounts' framing, which tilt toward the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no statutory punishment range.

attempt_completion.quote: Mother died immediately due to the gunshot wound.
attempt_completion.reason: The death occurred, so it is completed.

physical_harm.quote: Third and fourth ribs on the left side chest were broken. There was laceration on the left lung.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 2 charged (s.301/302 IPC and s.307/34 IPC); 0 finally upheld
number_of_offences.quote: charging appellant Ram Singh of having committed offence under Sections 301 and 302 of the IPC as well as under Section 307/34 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: The charges are s.301 r/w 302 and s.307; counting 3 sections is arguable, though ss.301/302 are charged together.

premeditation_planning.reason: The court made no finding on premeditation.

motive.quote: Because of this, they came to the door of his residence when on the instigation of Lala Ram, Ram Singh fired a shot
motive.reason: The alleged enmity is correctly marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence tendered by the eyewitnesses suffer from serious lacunae. Thus, their evidence cannot be said to be credible.

witness_credibility.quote: their evidence cannot be said to be credible

post_offence_conduct.quote: Ram Singh and Lala Ram ran away towards the north.
post_offence_conduct.reason: As alleged in the FIR and testimony.

bail_history.reason: The bail outcome is not stated.

trial_duration.reason: The FIR on 19.08.1982 says the incident was that evening, so the offence date is effectively given.
